title: Elements Ui App Mode Window Engagement
description: Implement Ui, App, Mode, Window, Engagement as canonical pure-React components in @elements/lib/react/core, add stories, rewire framework/playground renderers to compose them, replace Golden Layout with pure-React resizable layout.
summary: Implemented canonical pure-React shell components Ui, App, Mode, Window (extended), and Engagement in @elements/ui with resizable multi-pane Mode layout (react-resizable-panels), active-window focus, and floating three-line Engagement overlay. Replaced Golden Layout UICanvas with ShellModeCanvas in @elements/framework-react and @elements/playground/react; ProductView and PlaygroundView now compose Ui/App/ShellModeCanvas. Added Storybook stories (Ui, App, Mode, Engagement) and extended Window.stories. Removed golden-layout dependency and CSS. All vitest suites pass for @elements/ui (82), @elements/framework-react (7), and @elements/playground (8).
